sourceClaims.claim: Simple, Customize and Basic are three distinct source compositions with source-specific typography and geometry
optional regions generalize the source compositions without owning application empty-data state

evidence.source-integrity: pass: three source variants and their distinct typography/geometry are checked against extracted source references
evidence.structural-contract: pass: all five roots are classified and optional visual/title/description/action regions remain composable
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: Empty State owns no loading, retry, announcement or visibility controller
evidence.accessibility: pass: no gratuitous alert/status role is added, heading level remains consumer-owned and nested actions stay native
evidence.focused-visual: pass: computed variant geometry and source-specific typography are asserted without broad snapshot substitution
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace renders Empty State for an application-owned zero-result condition and reset recovers rows
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long title/description and action remain contained in a narrow fluid composition

staticVisual: pass: Simple, Customize and Basic source matrices are static composition evidence
realInteractionVisual: not-applicable: Empty State has no root hover, focus, active or disabled interaction contract
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: empty-data lifecycle and nested Button/Link behavior are consumer or nested-family owned

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: all source variants, long title/description, narrow container and nested action focus integration inspected

findings.description: The exact subdued Empty/Simple title paint measures about 2.79:1 on white, below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold; Wave 5 preserves source authority rather than silently recoloring it.

knownLimitations: dynamic announcements are consumer-owned and are not implied by ordinary empty presentation
